title: CBI arrests three over a 'digital arrest' fraud on a retired government employee
summary: Three men were detained in Odisha and Rajasthan for allegedly cheating a retiree of about Rs 2.07 crore. Investigators say the money was moved through several bank accounts and a trust.

title: Six held after raids in Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Gujarat over Rs 92 crore in digital arrest scams
summary: Mohali police arrested six people from two gangs after coordinated raids. Two more suspects were already in custody and two are still at large.

title: The digital arrest scam that made the Supreme Court take notice
summary: A retired couple in Haryana were held on a 'digital arrest' for about ten days by people posing as police and federal investigators. After they wrote to the court, it took up the issue and asked states to report related cases.
